meta.title: Where to Stay in DA NANG 2026: Best Areas, Hotels & Local Tips
meta.description:

comments.author: @parasitius
comments.text: $300 are you sure? This is 2025 not 2022? Already saw 2 YouTubers this week (1234ASIA) warning that the real prices after recent inflation is about 1000 USD for rent and 2000 total living expenses to get by. They said 300 USD rent is a thing of the past. I'm sure I'm more comfortable in Germany, France etc. without the heat, scammers, and poverty around - yet the cost is exactly the same to live nomadically here in Europe as vietnam per my understanding. So why are people still flocking to Vietnam at this point? I have all my utilities included, internet, all that jazz in Germany 800 euro/month.

comments.author: @moksha2280
comments.text: Awful place, just horrible to be. Tempted with all marketing on YT I came to NT and HoiAn very excited. Little did I realize it is good looking attractive hell. Very busy, noisy, drills and hammers all over, contruction everyhere but this is not the worst part: people, I mean locals. They do anything and I mean anything to get $ off you: they lie, cheat and steal. Danang beach you cannot leave things and go swim - as entering beach other expats worned me not to leave things. Traffic is "me me me" - everytime you cross road is near death exp; hotels are never what pics show and staff lie - they eneter room when you are still in, rushing you to check out; propaganda posters and communist symbol everywhere; everyda news and propaganda via speakers on the street; locals are just rude - I asked them not to smoke in the bus (yes, they smoke on the bus) and they laughhed at me. Hoi An is amazing place but as soon as you get out for a stroll banch of Vietnames attacts you to sell sth and they are really aggresive with tauching etc. Yes, nature is amazig but there are no price tags in Hoi An shops and markets you get overpriced things all the time, and they wont give you change. Never have I ever seen such greed, rude and selfish people. Awful experience.
